headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 11, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies suffered a 10-2 loss to the Detroit Tigers, while the New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals. The Kansas City Royals fell to the Baltimore Orioles 3-5, and the Chicago Cubs were shut out by the Cincinnati Reds 4-0.

Injuries continue to plague several teams, with Victor Bericoto being placed on the 10-day injured list by the San Francisco Giants due to a left oblique strain. Other notable injuries include Mick Abel's right elbow inflammation, Zack Gelof's right knee laceration, Mark Vientos' right hand fracture, Jake Irvin's right shoulder strain, Matt McLain's left calf strain, Tanner Banks' left forearm strain, and Brad Lord's left side tightness.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place, including the Pittsburgh Pirates acquiring Brandon Eisert from the Chicago White Sox in exchange for Jaden Woods and future considerations. The Minnesota Twins acquired Tommy Nance from the Toronto Blue Jays for Ryan Sprock and future considerations.

top_news.title: **Phillies Suffer 10-2 Loss to Tigers**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies fell short in a lopsided matchup against the Detroit Tigers, ultimately losing 10-2. Aaron Nola led the Phillies' pitching effort, throwing 5.0 innings with 8 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Nationals 5-3**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, with James Wood leading the Nationals' offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 1 RBI. Ryan Weathers pitched 5.1 innings for the Nationals, striking out 6 batters and allowing 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall to Orioles in 3-5 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals suffered a 3-5 loss to the Baltimore Orioles, with the Orioles taking the win. Samuel Basallo led the Royals' offense with a home run and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **Cubs Fall to Reds in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs suffered a 4-0 loss to the Cincinnati Reds, marking their final score in the game. Hunter Greene led the Reds to victory with a strong 7.0 innings pitched, striking out 12 batters and allowing no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Giants Place Victor Bericoto on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants right fielder Victor Bericoto has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left oblique strain. The injury occurred on July 10, 2026.

top_news.title: **Pirates Acquire Brandon Eisert in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates have acquired left-handed pitcher Brandon Eisert from the Chicago White Sox in exchange for left-handed pitcher Jaden Woods and future considerations. Eisert joins the Pirates' roster after being traded.
